notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), ventoy: Ventoy2Disk/Ventoy2Disk/DiskService_vds.c through Ventoy2Disk/Ventoy2Disk/WinDialog.c. These 78 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 46 FP, 32 TP.

SHAPE CALL FOR REVIEW: DiskService_vds.c rows on arrays returned by Windows VDS COM methods (QueryVolumeGuidPathnames, QueryPartitions) are TP medium: the S_OK/count tests prove the status and count, not the array, and a platform API contract outside ISO C and POSIX is not proof under the 2026-10-07 strict reading. TP shapes also: PhyDrive.c pGptInfo from an unchecked malloc at InstallVentoy2PhyDrive and the same pointer reaching VentoyFillGpt in Utility.c (p->arr and &p->f apply -> and are dereference sites; only &*p and &p[i] are excluded); a JSON buffer left NULL by an ignored ReadWholeFileToBuf failure. FP shapes: correlations on pPhyDrive->PartStyle; ReadWholeFileToBuf success; g_language_data and the CLI-mode pPhyDrive, each with a single checked writer ordered before every use (medium for the cross-file chains).

23 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
